rules.dialogHint: When X happens, the map does Y by itself. Runs are never counted or billed.
rules.empty: No rules yet. Create the first one — e.g. “when a node is done, assign the next person and send a message”.
rules.namePlaceholder: e.g. Design done → hand over to production
rules.noConditions: No conditions — the rule fires on every occurrence of the trigger.
rules.dlEvalHint: Evaluated once a day in the background (not on save). “N days overdue” means at least N days past the deadline — it also catches deadlines that expired before the rule existed, and fires once.
rules.hourHint: h — runs within the following hour

triggers.file_uploaded: a file is uploaded to a node

rules.outlinePlaceholder:
Prepare materials
  Write the brief
  Approve the budget
rules.outlineHint: Each line = a node; two-space indent = sub-level. Attached under the node that fired the rule.
rules.toDeputyOfOwner: the deputy of the responsible person
rules.targetDeputyOfOwner: the deputy of the responsible person (resolved at run time)
rules.grpPositionHolder: the holder of a position (at run time)
rules.grpPositionDeputy: the deputy of a position (at run time)
rules.deputyTargetHint: The deputy is looked up when the rule runs — staff changes never break the rule. If no deputy is set, the action is skipped and logged. Deputies are set by the admin in Organization settings.
rules.agentHint: The run is queued and dispatched within a minute. The registry controls who may run the agent.
rules.confirmDelete: Delete rule “{{name}}”? Its run log stays.
rules.nodePanelEmpty: No rule targets this node yet.
rules.waitMissingWarn: This node does not have “Wait for children” enabled (Behavior category) — it will never unblock, so the rule will never fire.
rules.waitMissingFix: Enable waiting for children on this node together with saving the rule
rules.afterUnblockEmpty: Once the children are done the node unblocks and the responsible person gets notified. Nothing else happens automatically yet.
rules.notifyHint: Delivered as an in-app notification; additionally by e-mail per the recipient's notification settings.
rules.templatesHint: A template is a saved rule shape shared across maps. Loading it creates a copy in this map — editing the template later does not change it.
rules.templatesEmpty: No templates yet. Click the bookmark “Save as template” on a rule in the list.
rules.templateSaved: Template “{{name}}” saved — find it in any map under “From template”
rules.confirmDeleteTemplate: Delete template “{{name}}”? Rules already loaded from it stay in their maps.
rules.outlineRichWarn: This sub-node template was created via the API and carries extra fields (owner, deadline…). Leave the text untouched to keep them; editing it reduces the template to plain titles.
rules.targetTrigger: the one that fired the rule
rules.moveHint: Moves the node that fired the rule under the selected node (appended at the end of the row). The kanban building block: on "Done" the card travels to the next column.

kanban.hint: Kanban columns are sibling nodes in one row (e.g. the 8D disciplines). The wizard creates one rule per step: a card under a column marked Done moves under the next column, gets its owner and returns to To do. The rules then live in the overview and can be edited individually.
kanban.notEnough: The selected node has no siblings in its row — kanban needs at least two columns side by side.
kanban.ownersHint: Who works on a card once it arrives at the column (optional):
kanban.limitWarn: The map would exceed the {{max}}-rule limit — delete unused rules or pick a shorter row.
kanban.alreadyWarn: This row already has kanban rules — enabling again would duplicate them. Edit the existing ones in the overview instead.

rules.toolbarKanbanTitle: This map runs kanban — the move rules own the layout. Arrange returns once you disable them in the ⚡ overview.
rules.pickAgentRegistry: — pick an agent from the registry —

importSummary.skipped_one: {{count}} rule was skipped — it could not be created on this map.
importSummary.skipped_few: {{count}} rules were skipped — they could not be created on this map.
importSummary.skipped_many: {{count}} rules were skipped — they could not be created on this map.
importSummary.skipped_other: {{count}} rules were skipped — they could not be created on this map.
